headline: UK Explores Alternative Revenue Options as Chancellor Prepares Budget
summary: UK Chancellor John Healey is weighing revenue options to increase fiscal headroom in his first Budget without raising income tax, as households face sustained cost-of-living constraints.
why: The UK Budget defines government borrowing targets, public investment ceilings, and tax policies that influence UK gilt markets and sterling valuation.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Adjusting indirect or wealth levies without changing income tax alters fiscal room and corporate tax burdens.
